newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmenistan to host U.N. forum on Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Turkmenistan to host U.N. forum on Afghanistan.

text.p: Turkmenistan will host a United Nations-sponsored forum in January focusing on aid to war-torn Afghanistan, the official Turkmen-Press news agency said on Monday.
The conference will be held on January 21-22 in the desert nation's capital Ashgabat, the agency said.

Afghanistan's political, social and economic problems are to be discussed by officials from several states including Russia and the United States. Representatives from major international lending institutions will also be present.

The fighting in Afghanistan following the fall of the capital Kabul in September to the radical Islamic Taleban militia has sent political shockwaves through the adjacent former Soviet republics of Central Asia.
Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarbayev, who hosted a similar regional conference in October, said at the start of a three-day visit to India on Monday of the fighting in Afghanistan:
"None of the Central Asian states wants fundamentalism to permeate their societies."

Islamist guerrillas in Tajikistan operate out of bases in neighbouring Afghanistan while the collapse of the Soviet Union has also seen a large portion of the Afghan drugs trade routed along the ancient silk road.
